claim: The same Sri Lankan armed forces that engage civilian and commercial life in the north also appear as valued contributors to a Buddhist heritage-restoration project at Mihintale in 2024.
bounded_by: This establishes a shared governance instrument across regions, not equivalent reception, legitimacy, coercion or land relations.
notes: Internal comparator removes the different-state confounder while retaining ethnic composition, wartime memory, land dispossession, commission structure and religious/administrative purpose as confounders.
